blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRaGAN.
blocks.zh: 雷达是天气扰动感知的关键方式。 与相机和LiDAR等光学传感器不同,雷达由于波长较长而能穿透出雾,雨和雪,而近期的硬件进步也稳步地提高了空间分辨率,从而使其与自主系统越来越相关. 虽然处理原始雷达数据需要大量的内存计算,但大多数现有工作都侧重于类似于LiDAR的预处理点-云数据. 然而,稀疏的雷达点和传感器相对的同位素使得以LiDAR为导向的编码器不尽人意. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了DRAGAN,一个动态的多雷达点云的图注网络. DRAGAN引入了传感器相对的Fourier角和射程编码来捕捉固定孔径雷达特性,沿每个传感器的视线有门的短程和长程中枢节点,用于高效的局部-全球信息传递,并用注意力制导动态重接来推倒微弱的边缘并增加限量的潜在连接,仅限于双跳相邻. 这减少了更深层中被加工的边缘数量,同时保持了代表质量. 在卡车上,DRaGAN将试验NDS比评估的雷达GN基线改进了10.10分,并将所报告的FLOP模型数减少了63.7%。 这种取舍包括将模型延迟度从40米提高到53.16米,将可训练参数从1.2M提高到1.7M,用于评价执行情况。 在https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRAGAN上可以查到代码和预先训练过的模型。

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Radar provides a complementary sensing modality for autonomous vehicles and robots, particularly in adverse weather. Due to its longer operating wavelength, radar is generally less affected by atmospheric scattering than camera or LiDAR, whose visibility, range, and measurement quality heavily degrade in fog, rain, and snow [ 1 ] . Radar sensors are low-cost and can be mounted behind RF-transparent body panels, offering protection from direct contamination. Radar point clouds are considerably sparser than LiDAR, thereby reducing downstream data volume and enabling faster processing with lightweight models. Although radar lacks high-resolution geometric detail, it directly measures radial (line-of-sight) Doppler velocity, a strong cue for identifying and characterizing dynamic objects [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 雷达为自主飞行器和机器人提供了辅助感知方式,特别是在恶劣天气中. 由于运行波长较长,雷达受到大气散射的影响一般低于相机或LiDAR,其能见度、射程和测量质量在雾、雨和雪中严重退化[1]。 雷达传感器费用低廉,可以安装在RF-透明机身板后,提供防止直接被污染的保护. 雷达点云比LiDAR要少得多,从而减少了下游的数据量并使得能够用轻量级模型进行更快的处理. 虽然雷达缺乏高分辨率几何细节,但它直接测量光圈(视线) 多普勒速度(Doppler modelity),是识别并描述动态物体的有力提示 [2].

blocks.en: Recent approaches have demonstrated the capability of radar-only perception by relying on raw FFT processed recordings [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] , but large data and model sizes limit real-time system integration [ 2 ] . Thus, a sparser data representation in the form of point-clouds is preferred. Notably, point-cloud processing techniques adapted from the LiDAR domain [ 6 ] introduce significant discretization errors and computational overhead when applied to sparse points distributed over a large area. Therefore, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown strong potential for modeling non-Euclidean radar data with high accuracy [ 7 ] . Several methods have constructed graphs directly on radar points and applied GNN-based feature extraction for downstream tasks like object detection and segmentation [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] . However, existing work tends to treat radar points similar to LiDAR recordings and does not consider unique recording properties of fixed-aperture radar from multiple sensors. Additionally, computationally expensive graph edge connections are currently generated statically and persist between irrelevant node pairs, which increases arithmetic load in deeper network layers. We address this research gap.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法通过依靠原始的FFFT处理的录音[3,4,5]证明了仅能被雷达感知的能力,但大数据和模型尺寸限制了实时系统集成[2]. 因此,更倾向于以点-克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 值得注意的是,从LiDAR域[6]中改编的点-云处理技术在应用到分布在大面积的稀有点时,引入了重大的盘状差错和计算间接费用. 因此,图神经网络(GNNs)已经显示出以高精度来模拟非欧克利德雷达数据的强大潜力[7]. 几种方法在雷达点上直接构建出图表,并将基于GNN的地物提取用于物体探测和分块等下游任务[8,9,10]. 然而,现有工作倾向于处理与LiDAR录音相类似的雷达点,不考虑从多传感器获取的固定孔径雷达的独特记录特性. 此外,计算出昂贵的图边连接目前是静态生成的,在不相关的节点对之间持续存在,这增加了更深层的算术负载. 我们处理这一研究差距。

blocks.en:
Specifically, we introduce DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network tailored to point clouds acquired by multiple fixed-aperture radars distributed around a vehicle. DRaGAN targets to reduce the arithmetic work of graph message passing while preserving local and cross-sensor information exchange. Unlike rotating LiDAR, fixed-aperture radar measurements exhibit viewing-angle-dependent variations in return intensity, noise, localization uncertainty, and Doppler characteristics relative to the sensor boresight [ 11 ] . To represent these spatially varying measurement properties, we employ a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of each point’s range and off-boresight angle, complemented by learned sensor-specific embeddings. Local message passing is performed on a graph constructed from spatial and Doppler proximity. Furthermore, attention-guided graph refinement reduces the number of node-node edges processed in deeper layers by pruning weak connections and introducing a bounded number of latent-space connections. We evaluate both operation count and realized latency because reduced arithmetic complexity does not necessarily imply faster execution for irregular sparse workloads. To enhance global context aggregation, we introduce sensor-specific short-range and long-range hub nodes that facilitate region-aware information exchange across the graph. We evaluate DRaGAN on the large-scale TruckScenes dataset [ 12 ] , which contains dense radar measurements from six vehicle-mounted sensors with sensing ranges of up to 200 m.
The main contributions of this work are: • A sensor-relative Fourier encoding that represents the range- and viewing-angle-dependent characteristics of distributed fixed-aperture radars. • Gated short- and long-range sensor hubs that enable controlled local-to-global and cross-sensor information exchange. • An attention-guided rewiring strategy with bounded two-hop candidate generation that reduces node-node edge processing in deeper layers. • A joint evaluation of detection performance, operation count, graph size, and realized GPU latency, exposing the trade-off between arithmetic complexity and sparse-operator efficiency.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,我们引入了DRAGAN,一个动态的图注网络,专门用来处理分布在一辆车周围的多颗固定孔雷达获得的点云. DRAGAN的目标是在保留本地和跨传感器信息交换的同时,减少图文传递的算术工作. 与旋转LiDAR不同的是,固定孔径雷达测量在返回强度、噪音、本地化不确定性以及相对于传感器的多普勒特性方面显示取景-角依赖变化[11]。 为了代表这些空间差异的测量特性,我们采用了传感器相对的Fourier编码,对每个点的射程和离孔角进行编码,并辅之以所学的传感器特定嵌入。 本地消息的传递是通过空间和多普勒相近的图来完成的. 此外,以注意为指南的图表精细化,通过推开薄弱的连接并引入限定数量的潜在-空间连接,减少了在更深层中处理的节点-节点边缘的数量. 我们既评估行动计数,又评估已实现的延迟,因为计算复杂程度的降低并不一定意味着对不规则的稀少工作量加快执行。 为加强全球背景汇总,我们采用了传感器专用的短程和长程中枢节点,这些节点有助于整个图上的区域认识信息交流。 我们在大型卡车扫描数据集上评估了DRaGAN,该数据集载有从6个车载传感器测得的密集雷达测量数据,其感测范围可达200米。
这项工作的主要贡献是: • 一种能代表分布式固定孔径雷达的射程和取景角依赖特性的感应-相对的傅里叶编码. 二. 支助 • 长长短距离传感器中心,能够进行有控制的局部到全球和跨传感器信息交流。 以双跳候选生成为边框的受关注制导重接策略,在更深层中减少节点-节点边缘处理. 二. 支助 联合评价检测性能,操作计数,图表大小,以及已实现的GPU活性,暴露出算术复杂度与稀有操作效率之间的取舍.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Automotive Datasets
blocks.zh: II-A 汽车数据集

blocks.en: The growing interest in radar-based perception has led to the inclusion of high-quality radar data alongside LiDAR and camera imagery in several large-scale automotive datasets. Due to memory constraints, most datasets provide radar data exclusively as sparse point clouds [ 13 , 14 , 12 ] , with notable exceptions such as RaDIal [ 15 ] and RaDICal [ 16 ] , which provide raw ADC time-series data, and K-Radar [ 3 ] , which offers FFT-processed tensors.
blocks.zh: 对以雷达为基础的感知越来越感兴趣,因此将高质量的雷达数据同LiDAR和相机图像一起纳入几个大型汽车数据集. 由于内存限制,大多数数据集提供雷达数据完全作为稀有点云[13,14,12],但显著例外,如提供原始ADC时间序列数据的RaDIal [15]和RaDICal [16],以及提供FFT处理的收分数的K-Radar [3].

blocks.en: Radar data quality also varies substantially across datasets. NuScenes [ 13 ] , originally designed with a focus on camera and LiDAR, provides only sparse 2D + Doppler radar points from five surrounding sensors. In contrast, View-of-Delft [ 14 ] and TJ4DRadSet [ 17 ] offer denser 3D + Doppler points, but from a single front-facing sensor only. This increased data density has enabled current radar-only detection methods to achieve competitive performance. However, such single-sensor setups fail to reflect real-world automotive configurations, where radar sensors are distributed around the vehicle to capture the complete surrounding scene.
blocks.zh: 各种数据集的雷达数据质量也有很大差异。 NuScens [13],最初设计以相机和LiDAR为焦点,只提供稀有的相机. 2D + 多普勒雷达从周围5个传感器得到点. 相比之下,Video-of-Delft [14] 和TJ4DRadSet [17] 提供密度更高的 3D +多普勒指向,但仅从单个前置传感器取出. 数据密度的提高使目前的雷达探测方法能够实现竞争性能。 然而,这样的单传感器设置未能反映现实世界的汽车配置,在车辆周围分布有雷达传感器来捕捉完整的周边场景.

blocks.en: To evaluate multi-sensor radar point-cloud perception under realistic operating conditions, we use the TruckScenes dataset [ 12 ] , which provides dense 3D + Doppler radar measurements from six sensors distributed around a truck and covers diverse long-range driving scenarios up to 200 m, including adverse weather conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了评价在现实操作条件下的多传感器雷达点-云能感知,我们使用卡车场景数据集[12],该数据集提供密度 3D + 多普勒雷达从6个分布在一卡车周围的传感器中进行测量,并覆盖了高达200米的各种远距离行驶情景,包括恶劣的天气条件.

blocks.en: II-B Automotive Radar Perception
blocks.zh: 二-B 汽车雷达感知

blocks.en: Automotive 77 GHz radar sensors directly measure range and Doppler velocity with high precision while estimating the angle of arrival. By applying Fast Fourier Transforms (FFT) to the mixed transmit and receive signals, the sensor generates a multi-dimensional spectrum whose peaks encode target position and velocity. Peak detection is then used to produce a radar point cloud [ 18 ] . As a result, point characteristics depend on their location relative to the radar boresight [ 11 ] . While this representation reduces downstream memory requirements, it discards substantial information contained in the original radar spectrum [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 汽车 77 GHz雷达传感器在估计到达角度的同时,以高精度直接测量射程和多普勒速度. 通过将"快变形"(Fast Fourier Transformes (FFT))应用到混合的传输和接收信号上,传感器产生出一个多维频谱,其峰值能编码目标位置和速度. 峰地探测再出出雷达点云[18]. 因此,点的特征取决于相对于雷达的比分[11]. 虽然这种表述降低了下游内存的要求,但它抛弃了原雷达频谱中包含的大量信息[4].

blocks.en: Recent ML-based radar perception methods have demonstrated a substantial performance improvement by learning from denser raw data representations, such as FFT spectra [ 5 , 4 ] or reduced radar cube [ 3 ] . In contrast, radar point clouds have typically been processed using voxel- or pillar-based encoding methods adapted from the LiDAR domain [ 19 ] . However, the resulting feature maps are often too sparse for radar-only perception, necessitating fusion with complementary modalities such as LiDAR or camera [ 20 , 21 ] . SpaRC [ 20 ] proposes a sparse radar-camera fusion transformer that combines image features and transformer-encoded radar point clouds through multi-stage cross-attention, using range-adaptive radar refinement and query-based object decoding to improve 3D object detection performance. HyDRa [ 21 ] improves radar-camera fusion by jointly leveraging radar and image features for depth-aware BEV representation learning, achieving state-of-the-art performance in 3D object detection and semantic occupancy prediction.
blocks.zh: 最近的基于ML的雷达感知方法通过从更密集的原始数据表示学来证明显著的性能改进,例如FFT光谱[5,4]或收缩的雷达立方体[3]. 相形之下,雷达点云的处理通常使用从LiDAR域改编而成的以voxel-或柱为主的编码方法[19]. 然而,由此产生的地物图往往过于稀少,无法仅用于雷达的感知,因此需要用LiDAR或相机等互补模式进行聚变[20,21]. SpaRC [20]提出一个稀疏的雷达-相机聚变变器,通过多相相相接而结合图像特征和变速器编码的雷达点云,利用测距适应雷达的精度和基于查询的物体解码来提高3D物体探测性能. HyDRA [21]通过联合利用雷达和图像特征来进行深意识BEV的表示学习,在3D物体探测和语义占用预测中实现最先进的性能来改进雷达-相机聚变.

blocks.en: II-C Graph-based Point Cloud Encoding
blocks.zh: II-C 基于图形的点云编码

blocks.en: Point clouds have become a popular representation for 3D sensory data such as radar and LiDAR. However, the non-euclidean irregularity of point clouds presents numerous challenges for traditional deep learning frameworks [ 7 ] . Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as effective methods for point-cloud processing because they naturally handle unordered, irregularly distributed detections while capturing local geometric relationships through graph-based message passing. Point-GNN [ 22 ] demonstrated that graph neural networks can operate directly on irregular LiDAR point clouds by modeling individual points as graph nodes and exchanging information through graph convolutions. The ability of GNNs to capture local geometric relationships in non-Euclidean point-cloud data motivated their adoption for naturally sparse automotive radar measurements, where graphs can be constructed directly on radar detections while additionally exploiting radar-specific attributes such as Doppler velocity [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] . Radar-PointGNN [ 9 ] constructs graph nodes directly from radar detections and iteratively propagates information through graph convolutions to learn contextual object representations from translation invariant features. RadarGNN [ 8 ] formulated a more general message passing neural network (MPNN) layer than graph convolution in [ 9 ] to consider edge features within the update process. The authors observed significant performance improvement for translation invariant features where global node coordinates are replaced by relative distance within the respective connecting edges while joint translation and rotation invariance showed no improvement. IRGNN [ 10 ] employs invariant graph representations along with an enhanced MPNN backbone that incorporates residual connections and virtual node layers for improved global context aggregation. Notably, existing radar-based GNN approaches rely on statically constructed graphs whose connectivity remains fixed throughout processing. Our work addresses this limitation by dynamically removing irrelevant edges and establishing new connections as node representations evolve.
blocks.zh: 点云已经成为了雷达和LiDAR等3D感知数据的流行代表. 然而,点云的非euclide非规则性对传统深层学习框架提出了众多挑战 [7]. 图形神经网络(GNNs)已作为点-云处理的有效方法而出现,因为它们自然处理无序,不规则地分布的检测,同时通过以图表为基础的消息传递来捕捉局部几何关系. Point-GNN [22] 证明图神经网络可以直接在不规则的LiDAR点云上运行,方法是将单个点作为图节点来建模,并通过图解来交换信息. GNNs在非欧克利得点-云数据中能够捕捉到本地几何关系,这促使它们采用自然稀疏的汽车雷达测量方法,在雷达探测上可以直接构建出图表,同时进一步利用多普勒速度等雷达特有属性[8,9,10]. 雷达点阵 [9] 直接从雷达探测中构建出图表节点,并通过图表演化来迭代地传播信息来从翻译的不常态特征中学习上下文对象的表示. RadarGNN[8]在[9]中制定了比图演化的更通俗的传递神经网络层(MPNN)来考虑更新过程中的边缘特征. 作者注意到,在翻译方面,全球节点坐标被相应连接边缘内的相距取而代之,而联合翻译和旋转变化则没有显示出任何改进。 IRGNN [10] 采用了变化无常的图示,同时采用了增强的MPNN主干线,其中包含剩余连接和虚拟节点层来改进全球环境汇总. 值得注意的是,现有的以雷达为基础的GNN方法依赖于静态构造的图,其连接在整个处理过程中保持不变。 我们的工作通过动态地去除无关的边缘和随着节点表达的演进建立新的连接来解决了这一限制.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: DRaGAN methodology overview.
blocks.zh: 图1:DRAGAN方法概述.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Fig 1 shows an overview of our proposed method. In contrast to existing graph-based approaches, we specifically tailor the encoding towards the physical properties of radar points coming from different sensor lines of sight (LoS) while maintaining a compact, dynamically adjusted graph size with local and global information exchange. First, a set of radar points p i s ∈ ℝ C p p_{i}^{s}\in\mathbb{R}^{C_{p}} is collected from each sensor, where C p C_{p} consists of position ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) , radial Doppler velocity v d v_{d} , radar cross section σ \sigma and sensor index s. Second, an initial graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is constructed based on k nearest neighbors (kNN) both in the spatial and Doppler domain, so that connectivity reflects rigid body motion coherence rather than spatial proximity alone. Since information exchange within 𝒢 \mathcal{G} is limited to local neighborhoods, we adapt the concept of virtual nodes [ 23 ] for stronger global context aggregation. Specifically, we extend 𝒢 \mathcal{G} by a set of short-range and long-range hubs located along the LoS of each sensor and additional edge connections to all points located inside the respective radar range. After graph construction, node features N n N_{n} and hub features H h H_{h} as well as connecting edge features E n ​ n E_{nn} , E n ​ h E_{nh} and E h ​ h E_{hh} are projected from the radar node and edge attributes. Next, we add a Fourier positional encoding which models the relative position of each radar point within the field of view of the respective sensor. Furthermore, the graph is iteratively refined by graph attention and dynamic rewiring layers. The GATv2Conv [ 24 ] based graph attention layer computes attention weights for all edge connections and performs weighted message passing between relevant nodes. To control graph complexity, each subsequent dynamic rewiring layer prunes weak node-node connections based on low attention scores and rewires previously unconnected nodes based on a latent similarity score of two-hop neighbors. After the graph refinement, three decoupled prediction heads estimate bounding box parameters, class labels and attributes for all node proposals which are then reduced and filtered by confidence to get the final set of object proposals.

GATv2Conv [24] 基于图表的注意层计算出所有边缘连接的注意分量并执行在相关节点之间传递的加权消息. 为了控制图的复杂程度,之后的每个动态再接层会以低关注分数为基础进行弱节点-节点连接,再接之前没有连接的节点则以潜在相似分数为双跳相邻. 在图表完善后,三个脱钩的预测头估计所有节点提案的边框参数、类标签和属性,然后通过置信来减少并过滤,以获得最终的一组对象提案。

blocks.en: III-B Sensor-Relative Fourier Positional Encoding
blocks.zh: 三- B 传感器- 弹性傅里叶定位编码

blocks.en: Since the angular resolution and reflection characteristics of a fixed-aperture radar vary with a point’s position within the sensor’s field of view [ 11 ] , each node is further characterized by its off-boresight angle β i \beta_{i} and logarithmic range μ i = log ⁡ ( 1 + r i ) \mu_{i}=\log(1{+}r_{i}) , both defined relative to the originating sensor rather than the ego frame. These quantities are encoded via Fourier features at F F increasing frequencies f k f_{k} , using the shorthand 𝐜 ⁡ ( θ ) = ( cos ⁡ θ , sin ⁡ θ ) \mathbf{c}(\theta)=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta) , γ ⁡ ( p i ) = [ 𝐜 ⁡ ( f k ​ β i ) , 𝐜 ⁡ ( f k ​ μ i ) ] k = 0 F − 1 , \gamma(p_{i})=\big[\,\mathbf{c}(f_{k}\beta_{i}),\ \mathbf{c}(f_{k}\mu_{i})\,\big]_{k=0}^{F-1}, (4) yielding a smooth representation of angle alongside a compact representation of range. To explicitly convey the increasing angular and cross-range uncertainty of returns observed near the periphery of the sensor’s field of view, two additional scalars proportional to 1 / cos ⁡ β i 1/\cos\beta_{i} are appended, rather than relying on the network to infer this behavior from γ ⁡ ( p i ) \gamma(p_{i}) alone. The resulting vector is linearly projected and combined with the node embedding along with a learned per-sensor identity embedding, enabling geometric reasoning to be shared across sensors while preserving the capacity to learn sensor-specific calibration effects.

blocks.en: III-C Node and Hub Graph Attention
blocks.zh: 三-C 节点和中枢图

blocks.en: The graph attention aims to compute the relevance between neighboring nodes, hubs, and node-hub pairs to support efficient information aggregation from multiple instances that carry semantic information about an object. The implementation is split into two parts with independent parameters. First, the node graph, represented by N ′ N^{\prime} and E n ​ n ′ E_{nn}^{\prime} , is propagated through L L stacked GATv2Conv [ 24 ] layers to perform inter-node message passing, where the edge count per node is usually small. Second, the hub graph, which includes H ′ H^{\prime} , N ′ N^{\prime} , E h ​ h ′ E_{hh}^{\prime} , and E n ​ h ′ E_{nh}^{\prime} , is passed through a separate set of L L GATv2Conv layers to perform inter-hub and hub-node information exchange, avoiding attention dilution that a single joint softmax would otherwise suffer from given the large disparity in node degree between hubs and ordinary nodes. Each hub receives aggregated messages weighted by attention scores from numerous nodes and from every other hub, while each node only receives one message, from its connected hub.
blocks.zh: 图形注意力旨在计算相邻的节点,中枢,和节点-hub对之间的关联性,以支持从多个带有关于某个对象的语义信息的实例中高效的信息聚合. 执行工作分为两个部分,有独立的参数。 首先,以N'"N^{\prime"和以"E_{nn}^{\n}^{\prime"为代表的节点图,通过L堆放的GATv2Conv [24]层来进行节点间消息传递,每个节点的边缘计数通常很小. 第二,枢机图,包括H ' H^{\prime}、N ′prime}、E h ′h_{prime}和E n h′nh}^{\prime},通过一个单独的L L GATv2 Conv层来进行枢纽和枢机-节点之间的信息交流,避免注意力分散,即由于枢机和普通节点之间的节点程度相差很大,一个单个联合软体否则会受损害。 每个中枢都收到来自众多节点和从其他中枢的以注意力分数加权的汇总信息,而每个中枢只收到来自其连通中枢的一条信息.

blocks.en: We observed that these hub-node messages may not be useful to all nodes and can even act as noise for some of them. To address this, each layer is equipped with a learned, channel-wise gate that conditions on both the node’s current state h i h_{i} and the incoming hub message m i m_{i} , g i = σ ( W g [ h i ∥ m i ] ) , h i ′ = h i local + g i ⊙ m i , g_{i}=\sigma\big(W_{g}\,[h_{i}\,\|\,m_{i}]\big),\qquad h_{i}^{\prime}=h_{i}^{\text{local}}+g_{i}\odot m_{i}, (5) where only relevant feature channels of m i m_{i} are passed through. The gate weights are initialized to zero with a negative bias, so hub information is largely suppressed at the start of training and can be selectively opened up where it is beneficial.

blocks.en: III-D Dynamic Rewiring
blocks.zh: 三-D 动态重接

blocks.en: Since the initial constructed graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} was generated solely based on spatial and Doppler proximity, it does not necessarily reflect the true node relations required to exchange meaningful object-specific context as well as contain unnecessary or weakly contributing graph structures that increase computation and memory. Following the notion of recomputing graph connectivity from evolving node features across layers [ 25 ] , the node-node edges are rewired after every GATv2Conv [ 24 ] layer using the computed attention scores and updated latent representations. Meanwhile, the hub structure is left unchanged since including it in the candidate search would let the high in-degree of hub nodes dominate the two-hop neighborhood computation. The dynamic rewiring is performed in three steps:
blocks.zh: 由于最初所构建的图G\mathcal{G}完全基于空间和多普勒相近性生成,因此它不一定反映交换有意义的对象特定上下文所需的真正节点关系,也不一定包含不必要的或微弱的贡献来增加计算和内存的图结构. 遵循从变化中的分层节点特征来重算图的连通性的概念[25],节点-节点边缘在使用计算出的关注分数和被更新的潜在表示值的GATv2Conv[24]分层后再被再接. 同时,枢纽结构没有改变,因为将它列入候选搜索中,将使高度的中枢节点主导了双跳相邻的计算. 动态重接分三个步骤进行:

blocks.en: Attention weights for an edge E n ​ n ′ ​ ( i , j ) E^{\prime}_{nn}(i,j) are averaged over all heads and the edge is retained only if it exceeds the mean attention received by its target node N n ′ ​ ( j ) N^{\prime}_{n}(j) . This allows the network to remove edges itself judged uninformative.
blocks.zh: En n (i, j) E^{\prime}_{nn } (i, j) 边缘的注意分数平均适用于所有人头,而边缘只有在超过其目标节点N n (j) N^{\prime}_{n (j) 收到的平均分数时才予以保留。 这使得网络能够去除边缘本身被判定为非信息化.

blocks.en: Potential candidate pairs to form a new edge connection are restricted to each node’s two-hop neighborhood in the pruned graph, obtained via a single sparse adjacency-squaring operation. This limits the candidate set to 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ⋅ k ¯ 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N\cdot\bar{k}^{2}) pairs, where k ¯ \bar{k} is the average node degree, rather than the 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) pairs a global search over the latent space would require.
blocks.zh: 建立新边缘连接的潜在候选对被限制在每个节点的双跳相邻区域, 这限制了候选人设置到 O \\ (N \ k \ k \ 2 )\ mathcal{ (N\ cdot\ bar{ k\ 2} ) 对等, k'\ bar{ k} 是平均节点, 而不是 O \ (N 2)\ mathcal{ O} (N\\ 2}) 对潜在空间进行全局搜索 。

blocks.en: Candidates are ranked by squared distance metric in the updated latent space where only the k ′ k^{\prime} nearest candidates per node are kept which allows the graph to form connections between nodes the network currently considers similar. As there are no physical edge attributes available for these latent-only connections, a learned linear projection is used in place: E n ​ n ′′ ​ ( i , j ) = W e ⁡ ( N n ′ ​ ( j ) − N n ′ ​ ( i ) ) E^{\prime\prime}_{nn}(i,j)=\operatorname{W_{e}}(N^{\prime}_{n}(j)-N^{\prime}_{n}(i)) (6) Finally, the updated node edges are combined with the unchanged hub edges and forwarded to the subsequent attention layer.
blocks.zh: 候选人在更新后的潜在空间中按平方距离衡量排名,每个节点只有k ' k^{\prime}最近的考生被保留,使图表能够在网络目前认为相似的节点之间建立联系。 由于这些只有潜伏连接没有物理边缘属性可用,因此使用了已学到的线性预测: En n → (i, j) = W e → (N n → (j) − N n (i) ). (i,j) 操作器名称{W_{e}}(N^{\prime}_{n} (j)-N^{\prime}_{n} (一)) (6)最后,更新后的节点边缘与未变的中枢边缘结合,并被传送到后续的注意层.

blocks.en: III-E Object Detection
blocks.zh: 三-E 物体探测

blocks.en: Following a center-based detection paradigm [ 6 ] , the refined graph’s node features are passed through three decoupled and task-specific detection heads which estimate bounding-box parameters, class labels and corresponding attributes. All heads are implemented as an MLP structure to operate directly on the graph in a per-node style. (I) The heatmap head proposes foreground object classes along with a confidence score at each spatial node location. (II) The regression head predicts 3D bounding box parameters ρ i = [ d ​ x , d ​ y , d ​ z , l , w , h , s ​ i ​ n ​ θ , c ​ o ​ s ​ θ , v x , v y ] \rho_{i}=[dx,dy,dz,l,w,h,sin\theta,cos\theta,v_{x},v_{y}] , where ( d ​ x , d ​ y , d ​ z ) (dx,dy,dz) represent the offset from the respective spatial node location. (III) The attribute head estimates class specific attributes which match the corresponding predicted object class. After the prediction, all boxes are assembled and per-class non-maximum suppression (NMS) is applied to remove duplicate proposals before arriving at the final set of boxes.
blocks.zh: 遵循以中为主的检测范式[6],被精炼的图的节点特征通过三个被分解并任务特定的检测头来传递,这些检测头估计出约束框参数,类标签和相应的属性. 所有头被作为MLP结构执行,以每个节点样式直接在图上运行. (一)热映射头提出前地物体类,并同时在每个空间节点位置得到置信分. ( 二 ) 回归 头 预测 3D 边框 参数 ^ i = [d x, d y, d z, l, w, h, s i n → , c o s , v x, v y]\rho_{i = [dx, dy, dz, l, w, h, sin\theta, cos\theta, v_{x], v_{y = , 其中 (dx, dx, dy,dz) 表示从相邻的空间节点位置得到的抵消. (三)属性头估计与相应的预测对象类相匹配的特定属性. 预测后,所有箱都组装并采用每等非最大压制(NMS)来去除重复的提议后再到达最后一组箱.

blocks.en: III-F Loss
blocks.zh: 三-F损失

blocks.en: The overall loss consists of four independent weighted terms: A focal-based heatmap loss ℒ h \mathcal{L}_{h} to optimize the object proposal prediction, a Smooth L1-based regression loss ℒ r \mathcal{L}_{r} to refine bounding box parameters ρ i \rho_{i} , a cross-entropy attribute loss ℒ a \mathcal{L}_{a} and, similar to [ 26 ] , an auxiliary Gaussian Wasserstein distance (GWD) loss ℒ g ​ w ​ d \mathcal{L}_{gwd} . ℒ = α h ​ ℒ h + α r ​ ℒ r + α a ​ ℒ a + α g ​ w ​ d ​ ℒ g ​ w ​ d \mathcal{L}=\alpha_{h}\mathcal{L}_{h}+\alpha_{r}\mathcal{L}_{r}+\alpha_{a}\mathcal{L}_{a}+\alpha_{gwd}\mathcal{L}_{gwd} (7) While ℒ h \mathcal{L}_{h} is computed over all nodes, ℒ r \mathcal{L}_{r} , ℒ a \mathcal{L}_{a} and ℒ g ​ w ​ d \mathcal{L}_{gwd} are only computed for nodes that fall inside a ground-truth bounding box and thus consider specific parameters from the respective box. Specifically, the GWD loss models each box as a Gaussian and measures distributional distance to the ground-truth box, refining shape and orientation beyond what SmoothL1 alone captures, since SmoothL1 treats each regression channel independently and does not directly penalize orientation and shape mismatch as a geometric quantity.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: To validate our method, we conduct experiments on the MAN TruckScenes [ 12 ] dataset, which provides dense radar point clouds from multiple sensors in different orientations which makes it an excellent fit. Our evaluation is performed according to the TruckScenes benchmark and results are compared with various multi-modal methods presented on the official test server as well as on the validation split. As primary metric we use the NuScenes Detection Score [ 13 ] , which is defined by the aggregation of mean Average Precision (mAP) and five mean True Positive (mTP) metrics. blocks.en: IV-A Training
blocks.zh: 四-A 培训

blocks.en: We train the model on a NVIDIA L40S GPU for 20 epochs using a batch size of 8. Optimization is performed using AdamW with an initial learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} and a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The learning rate is adjusted after each epoch using a cosine annealing schedule with a minimum learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} . The model contains 1.7 1.7 million trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个NVIDIA L40S GPU来训练这个型号,用于20个时代,使用批量尺寸为8个. 优化使用 AdamW 进行,初始学习率为 5× 10− 4 5\times 10× 4}体重衰减为 10− 4 10× 4}. 学习率在每一纪元之后都会使用一个余弦反射表进行调整,最低学习率为10-5-10-5}。 该型号包含170万个可训练参数.

blocks.en: IV-B Computational Complexity and Runtime
blocks.zh: IV-B 计算复杂性和运行时间

blocks.en: We evaluate real time performance and estimated computing requirements for edge platforms. Measurements are performed on the NVIDIA L40S with FP32 precision. We compare inference time, floating point operations (FLOPs), multiply-accumulate operations (MACs) and parameter counts with RadarGNN [ 8 ] . Table II shows that our method requires higher inference time (32.9%) than RadarGNN while reducing FLOP and MAC counts by 63.7%. The reduction in reported FLOPs and MACs does not translate into lower latency, where DRaGAN takes 53.16 ms versus 40 ms for RadarGNN and has 1.7M compared to 1.2M trainable parameters. Irregular operations such as dynamic rewiring and sparse message passing may contribute to the higher GPU latency. However, we do not isolate their contributions in this study.
blocks.zh: 我们评价边缘平台的实时性能和估计的计算要求。 在NVIDIA L40S上以FP32精度进行测量. 我们比较推论时间,浮点操作(FLOPs),乘积操作(MACs)和参数计数与雷达GN[8]. 表二显示,我们的方法需要比雷达GNN更高的推断时间(32.9%),同时将FLOP和MAC的计算减少63.7%。 所报告的FLOP和MAC的减少并没有转化为低潜性,DRAGAN在雷达GN中需要53.16 ms而40 ms,并且拥有1.7M而1.2M可被训练参数. 动态再接和消息流出等不规范的操作,可能导致GPU的延迟度较高. 然而,我们并不孤立它们在这项研究中的贡献。

blocks.en: IV-C Results
blocks.zh: 四-C 结果

blocks.en: The quantitative results in Table I show that DRaGAN improves all reported detection metrics over the evaluated RadarGNN [ 8 ] on the test split, increasing NDS from 10.78 to 20.88. The accuracy gain is accompanied by higher model-forward latency and a larger parameter count (Table II ). Whether this trade-off is preferable depends on the deployment constraints. DRaGAN’s mAAE increases from 0.0839 on validation to 0.3391 on test. This gap may partly reflect differences in the difficulty and attribute composition of matched detections across the splits, since mAAE is evaluated on matched detections rather than all ground-truth objects. Additionally we outperform all camera-only approaches [ 28 , 27 ] while getting close to HyDRa [ 21 ] radar-camera fusion. The evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves superior learning of object properties and motion attributes once objects are detected in the scene which suggests strong information exchange among nodes and effective use of radar specific attributes. Due to the special focus on including Doppler velocity in the graph construction as well as in both, node and edge features, DRaGAN reports the second lowest mean average velocity error (mAVE) on the test and validation set. We can observe that radar-only methods still show a lower mAP compared to other modalities, which is primarily attributed to complex scenes where sparsity still poses a challenge in separation of adjacent objects. However, the results show a promising behavior of radar-only sparse point-cloud perception on a challenging dataset.
blocks.zh: 表一中的定量结果显示,DRAGAN改进了所有报告检测度量表,超过了测试分期进行的雷达GN[8],将NDS从10.78增加到20.88。 精度增高的同时,模型前延性更高,参数计数也更大(表二. 这种权衡是否可取取决于部署方面的限制。 DRaGAN的mAAE在验证时从0.0839增加到了测试时的0.3391. 这一差距可能部分地反映了各部分匹配检测在难度和属性构成上的差异,因为mAAE是在匹配检测上而不是在所有地面真实物体上评价的. 此外,我们在接近HyDra[21]雷达相机聚变时,超越了所有只使用相机的方法[28,27]. 评估表明,一旦在现场检测到物体,我们的方法就能对物体的特性和运动属性进行更好的学习,这说明各节点之间可以进行强有力的信息交流并有效利用雷达特定属性。 由于特别注重将多普勒速度纳入到图表构造以及节点和边缘特征中,DRAGAN在测试和验证集上报告了第二低的平均速度出错(mAVE). 我们可以观察到,仅用雷达的方法仍然比其他模式显示的mAP更低,这主要归功于复杂的场景,在相邻物体的分离方面,斯帕克仍然构成挑战. 然而,结果显示,在一个具有挑战性的数据集上,只有雷达的零星点云感知是一种有希望的行为。

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 四-D 读取研究

blocks.en: Table III evaluates the contribution of the proposed architectural components by removing each component individually from the full DRaGAN model. Results were averaged over three runs to mitigate stochastic variance and reduce the likelihood of fortuitous outcomes. We compare the metrics NDS and mAP described in [ 13 ] as well as the mTPS contribution from Equation 9 .
blocks.zh: 表三评价拟议建筑构件的贡献,将每个构件单独从完整的DRAGAN模型中去除. 平均结果分三轮进行,以减小差异并减少偶然结果的可能性。 我们比较了[13]所描述的NDS和mAP的度量衡,以及从方程式9得到的mTPS的贡献.

blocks.en: Removing the Fourier encoding primarily reduces mTPS, indicating that sensor-relative geometry and off-boresight information improves the quality of estimated object properties after detection, rather than the number of correctly detected objects.
blocks.zh: 取出傅里叶编码主要会减少mTPS,表明传感器相接的几何和离孔信息在检测后会提高估计物体属性的质量,而不是正确检测出物体的数量.

blocks.en: A static graph degrades both mAP and mTPS and increases the inference time by 9.45 ms by retaining more edges in deeper layers. Averaged over the validation set, dynamic rewiring reduces the number of local edges from 364,662 in the first layer to 80,969 in the fourth layer, corresponding to a reduction of 77.8%. Since the 46,637 hub edges remain fixed, the total edge count decreases from 411,299 to 127,606, a reduction of 69.0% which results in faster processing (9.45 ms).
blocks.zh: 静态图可以同时降解mAP和mTPS,通过在更深的地层中保留更多的边缘来将推论时间增加9.45 ms. 平均在验证组上,动态再接力将局部边缘从第一层的364,662个减少到了第四层的80,969个,相当于减少了77.8%. 由于46 637个枢纽边缘仍然固定,总边缘计数从411 299个减少到127 606个,减少69.0%,从而加快了处理速度(9.45毫秒)。

blocks.en: Removing the sensor hubs causes a substantial mTPS reduction while mAP is significantly lower affected. This ablation tests the hub pathway, not the gate in isolation. The results are consistent with the hypothesis that hub-mediated context primarily improves bounding-box, motion, and attribute estimation for detected objects. It further supports the role of the hubs in exchanging contextual information across spatially separated radar regions.
blocks.zh: 拆除感应器中心可大大减少mTPS,而mAP的影响则要小得多。 试探枢纽通道 而不是隔离的大门 其结果与以下假设是一致的:以枢纽为媒介的上下文主要改进了被检测对象的边框,运动和属性估计. 它还支持各中心在空间分离的雷达区域之间交流背景信息方面的作用。

blocks.en: Removing graph attention causes the largest degradation in both mAP and mTPS, demonstrating that graph attention has the largest measured contribution among the evaluated components.
blocks.zh: 消除图的注意会导致mAP和mTPS中最大的退化,表明图的注意在被评价的组成部分中具有最大的测量作用.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented DRaGAN, a multi-radar-aware graph neural network that combines sensor-relative spatial encoding, gated sensor hubs, graph attention, and dynamic graph rewiring for radar-only 3D perception in autonomous driving. On the official TruckScenes benchmark, DRaGAN improves NDS by 10.10 points over the GNN-based radar-only baseline while reducing the estimated FLOP count by 63.7%. This improvement demonstrates the value of jointly modeling sensor-specific viewing geometry, Doppler-aware local relationships, and cross-sensor context. The lower arithmetic complexity currently comes with a 13.16 ms (32.9%) increase in model-forward latency on the tested GPU, potentially reflecting the cost of irregular sparse graph operations, whose individual contributions were not measured. These results support dynamic graph refinement as a way to reduce reported arithmetic operation count while improving detection performance relative to the evaluated baseline. The higher measured latency and parameter count remain limitations for latency- and memory-constrained deployment, which will be covered in future work.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了DRAGAN,一个多雷达-有意识的图形神经网络,它结合了传感器-相对空间编码,有门的传感器中枢,图的注意度,以及动态的图形重接,在自主驾驶中只用于雷达的3D感知. 在正式的"卡车扫描"基准上,DRAGAN将NDS比基于GNN的雷达唯一基线改进了10.10分,同时将估计的FLOP计数减少了63.7%. 这一改进表明了联合建模传感器特有取景几何,多普勒-认识局部关系,以及跨传感器上下文的价值. 算术复杂性较低,目前测试的GPU上模型后期增加为13.16毫秒(32.9%),可能反映出不规则的稀有图操作的成本,其个人贡献没有得到衡量。 这些结果支持了动态图表的完善,以此减少所报告的算术操作计数,同时相对于评估基准提高检测性能。 计量的延迟和参数计数较高,仍然是对延迟和内存限制部署的限制,今后工作将涵盖这些限制。
